_sources._note: Keys prefixed with an underscore are provenance comments and are ignored by parseMotionParams. JSON has no comment syntax; this block carries the citations rule 5 of the wave contract requires.
_sources.capsule.height: DECISIONS.md D8 gives h=1.7-1.8 (visuals deliberately taller); s10 contract fixes the ship value at 1.75, the midpoint.
_sources.collision.slopeLimitDegrees: DECISIONS.md D8 gives 'slope limit 45-50 (tune)'. SHIPPING 45. The 50 alternative is held here for the F-gate feel rounds and is deliberately NOT the shipped value: raising this key to 50 is the whole change. 44 must walk and 46 must slide at the shipped value.
_sources.gravity.terminalSpeedMetersPerSecond: DEVIATION: not in TUNING_V0 or D8. v0 placeholder bounding fall speed so a long fall cannot produce an unbounded per-tick sweep. 55 m/s is well past the 14m lethal threshold, so it never affects shipped falls.
_sources.jump.apexMeters: DECISIONS.md D8 — 'jump ~1.2m'. Launch speed is derived as sqrt(2*g*apex), never stored.
_sources.air.controlFactor: DEVIATION: not in TUNING_V0. v0 placeholder for airborne acceleration and turn authority as a fraction of grounded authority; souls-calibrated low-control default pending the F-gate.
_sources.fallDamage.lethalMeters: DEVIATION: D8 names the 6m threshold but no ceiling. v0 placeholder: a 14m fall is lethal.
_sources.fallDamage.curve: DEVIATION: D8 says 'scaling curve' without giving one. Piecewise-linear, sampled on t = (fall - safeMeters) / (lethalMeters - safeMeters) clamped to [0,1], returning damage as a fraction of maximum Pulse. Endpoints are exact by construction: t=0 yields 0 and t=1 yields 1.
_sources.landing: DEVIATION: not in TUNING_V0. v0 placeholders for landing recovery. softLagTicks applies under hardLandingMeters, hardLagTicks at or above it, fallDamageLagTicks whenever the fall did damage.
_sources.speeds.walk: DEVIATION: not in TUNING_V0. v0 placeholder for the analog walk band.
_sources.speeds.sprintMultiplier: DEVIATION: TUNING_V0 names the sprint Breath drain but no sprint speed. v0 placeholder multiplier on the run speed (6 * 1.45 = 8.7 m/s).
_sources.speeds.walkInputThreshold: DEVIATION: v0 placeholder. Analog stick magnitude at or below this maps into the walk band; above it interpolates to the run speed.
_sources.speeds.idleThreshold: DEVIATION: v0 placeholder. Horizontal speed at or below this reports the idle locomotion state.
_sources.breath.sprintDrainPerSecond: TUNING_V0.md Movement & defense — 'Sprint drain 11 Breath/s'. Breath regeneration is deliberately absent: the combat economy owns the pool and regen, this module only spends and reports.
_sources.acceleration: DEVIATION: not in TUNING_V0. v0 placeholder acceleration curve in m/s^2 sampled on speed/run clamped to [0,1], plus a no-input deceleration.
_sources.turnRateCurve: DEVIATION: not in TUNING_V0. v0 placeholder turn rate in rad/s sampled on speed/run clamped to [0,1] — turning tightens at low speed and widens at sprint.
